Solutions · Solution 02

Make invoicing part of a controlled, auditable digital process.

Electronic invoicing is not an isolated document-generation process. It sits between sales, finance, billing, tax reporting, customer records and the systems where the underlying transaction is created. Hamerkop approaches electronic invoicing as an integrated operational workflow so the invoicing layer works with the wider institution.

Request a ConsultationExplore Hamerkop EIMS

Scope

Electronic Invoicing

Electronic invoicing work covers Hamerkop EIMS, invoice and receipt workflows, validation, reporting, audit records and integration with ERP, finance, billing and point-of-sale environments.

Designed for

  • Organizations preparing for electronic invoicing requirements
  • Institutions that need invoicing connected to ERP, finance, billing or POS
  • Organizations managing complex invoice volumes or multiple operating locations
  • Teams that require clearer traceability around invoice status and reporting

Key capabilities

Electronic Invoicing

Invoice & receipt workflow

Structured creation, validation, status handling and record keeping.

System integration

Invoicing is connected with ERP, finance, billing and POS environments.

Reporting

Operational and regulatory reporting draws from structured transaction data.

Traceability

Important invoice events and workflow activity remain traceable through a clear transaction record.

Access

User roles separate the creation, management and review of invoice activity.

Implementation

EIMS is introduced around the organization’s existing invoicing process and the operational systems that feed it.
